notes: No build, no dependencies, no backend: a fresh worktree needs no setup (npm test runs Node's built-in test runner; Node 22+). The app is one page; Today / Nutrition / Workouts are tabs addressed by the URL hash (#today, #nutrition, #workouts). The Data & backup sheet opens from the header button (export/import JSON). All data lives in the browser's IndexedDB database 'genki', so a browser test starts from an empty profile; a different port is a different origin with its own data. The service worker registers only over https, so it never runs on localhost. CI is the Pages workflow (.github/workflows/pages.yml): it runs both stacks on every PR and on main before deploying. Public repo: never put real personal data in fixtures or tests.
